title: Fox cobblemon modpack
description: This is the official modpack to join Fox cobblemon server included with both performance and life quality mods
body:
This is the Official modpack for Fox cobblemon server that have all required mods in order 
to join But also packed with  life quality features!

Features-

- Optimizations: have mods like sodium/Ferritecore,Entity culling for keeping your game smooth
- Life Quality Features- Custom music support,Optifine features, Zoom,
- Server dependencies: Have all mods required to join server
